sideB.text:
DID NOT DELIVER: 851 AND ABOVE
The world is saved, but not the Faded. The century will be remembered as a dark time with light ahead. Utopia has the cure and will produce it at JADE, and will not give it to the Faded. The Hollow Men are free. The Faded will not see the new world and hope history remembers them as its saviors.

DID NOT DELIVER: 701-850
Some cities were saved and civilization has been rekindled. Utopia and the Hollow Men are at war. One of them will bring the sample to JADE and start producing a cure, and neither is expected to share it. What the Faded know is that they kept the world going when everyone else had given up.
